class_guess: Sync bouncer counter (SBCv8 TM31 cousin): binary counter left, ternary throttle right, nested overflow pause
summary: TM31 cousin: binary counter left, ternary throttle right; the overflow pause and a one-off creep are unruled
mechanism: The head shuttles between a left binary counter (6-cell digits) and a right ternary throttle, across 150 transparent middle blocks (0011 <-> 1110 per pass).
Each trip adds 1 on the left. On the right, s3 forwards 2 of 3 trips into K ternary digits; their carry-out appends one block, so a record comes every (3/2)*3^K trips.
A full left counter (3*2^m trips) starts an ~80*2^m-step pause. Only at m=14 did it end in a 150-trip creep that cost K a digit (3 -> 2). No halt to 2e11; hand tests with K=1,0,-1 keep running.

rules.name: RL left binary counter
rules.from: canonical point (head steps 300 -> 301), V = (D_15..D_1 D_0)_2 with D_i at cell -86+6(15-i), D_0 at 16..21; 0 = 001101, 1 = 101101
rules.steps: one round trip (about 1,250 steps + 8e on a record trip)
rules.cases: V < 2^16 - 1 (no overflow); the overflow case is rule OV

rules.name: RS first right digit s3 (cells 619..622)
rules.to: P -> Q, no carry | Q -> R, carry | R -> P, carry

rules.name: RT ternary throttle + record
rules.from: digits t_0..t_(K-1) at 623+4j (P=0, R=1, Q=2), marker 1011, (0011)^e, carry c from RS
rules.to: T + c; if T + c = 3^K: digits -> 0, the trip runs to the right end, right edge +4 (e -> e+1); else right edge unchanged

rules.name: RM middle is transparent
rules.from: cells 22..618 at a canonical point ((0011)^150, toggled to (1110)^150 by each rightward pass)
rules.to: the same cells at the next canonical point

rules.name: OV left overflow (empirical, ordinary case)
rules.from: left counter full after 3*2^m trips (minus the previous residual)
rules.to: pause of about 80*2^m steps confined to cells -90..50; counter restarts with residual 10..23; middle and right counter unchanged
rules.cases: fails once: m = 14 ends with a 150-trip creep that rebuilds the middle; the throttle loses its top digit (K 3 -> 2), residual 77

template.module: TM31 (nonhalt via Longitudinal segRLs lemmas, BigStep312, progress_nonhalt_cond)
template.diff: F1: 0RD (ours) vs 0RE (TM31); the other 11 transitions are equal
template.note: Same vocabulary and layout: the 10 wall, d = 011011 blocks on the left (our binary digits), w = 0011/0110 blocks in the middle, and a (1110)^e right region. Simulated TM31: its tape at right records reads 0^inf 10 ...(1011)^30 0 (1101)^451 ... (1110)^4416, but its right edge grows in bursts (no right record from 4.65e8 to 1e9). Ours grows steadily under a ternary P/Q/R throttle and has nested overflow pauses. Reuse the segRLs transfer-lemma machinery (Incs_d/Incs_w style, DivModCases for the mod-3 digits), not TM31's P ls i c invariant or BigStep312.

strategy:
Longitudinal proof like TM31: segRLs transfer lemmas per block (binary d digits, ternary P/Q/R digits, transparent 0011 middle).
Invariant over (V, wall state, s3, T, K, e, middle length). Blocker: rules for the overflow pause and the creep (rule OV).
risks: The overflow pause has no rules yet: an inner counter in the middle receives about 2^m trips, and how it exits decides creep vs no creep.
The creep trigger (only m = 14 among m = 9..18) may depend on arithmetic such as the base-3 digits of ~2^m. That would be cryptid-like in when it happens, though K drops proved harmless in tests.
Hand tests show K = 1, 0, -1 keep running, but what a creep does once no ternary digits are left is untested.
